summary: Iteration 5 (₹35 Recharge bug fix): Full backend + frontend regression PASSED. 56/56 pytest tests pass (1 skipped ffmpeg env-gap). Added 3 new renewal-logic tests to TestRazorpayVerifyPayment: (a) test_renewal_extends_expiry_when_active — seeds a user with active daily plan and FUTURE plan_expires_at (now+12h), calls create-order + HMAC-signed verify-payment for the SAME plan (daily), asserts new plan_expires_at ≈ prev_future_expiry + 1 day (within 5s) AND > prev+23h (i.e. NOT reset to now+1d). (b) test_renewal_resets_expiry_when_expired — seeds past expiry (now-2d), renews daily, asserts new expiry ≈ now+1d (not stacked on the past date). (c) test_renewal_different_plan_resets_from_now — seeds active daily (future expiry) but buys WEEKLY, asserts weekly expiry ≈ now+7d (does NOT stack on the daily's future date). All three pass. Backend renewal logic in server.py:805-828 is correct: `base = current_expiry if (current_plan==plan_id and current_expiry>now) else now; expires_at = base + timedelta(days=plan['duration_days'])`. Idempotency remains intact via payment_transactions.status!='completed' guard. Frontend UI (desktop 1920x1080, admin@liveadda.com with active monthly plan): /dashboard/billings shows all three plan cards with data-testid=buy-plan-{daily|weekly|monthly}; ALL THREE BUTTONS ARE ENABLED (verified is_disabled()==False); daily+weekly labeled 'Buy Now', monthly (admin's current plan) labeled 'Renew / Recharge' — this IS the main bug fix. Clicking the admin monthly 'Renew / Recharge' button opens the Razorpay checkout iframe (api.razorpay.com/v1/checkout/public) confirming the current-plan renewal flow works end-to-end (modal not paid — LIVE keys). Screenshot captured. Registration for a truly-fresh test user via the /register page did not complete in the browser session (create-account button click did not navigate), so the fresh-no-plan Buy-Now UI path was validated via the admin's daily card (which also renders 'Buy Now' and opens Razorpay for ₹35) — same code path.

minor.issue: Razorpay LIVE keys (rzp_live_TD9A1ftJY2hkbx) are intermittently rate-limited by the provider — direct curl confirms ~1 successful order per ~30-60s window, then 'Authentication failed' for subsequent calls; the backend correctly surfaces this as 502 'Failed to create Razorpay order' (see server.py:734). Not a regression: same behavior in iteration 4. Handled in tests via _create_order_with_retry (6 retries × 8s backoff). Only affects test throughput, not real end-users (a user manually clicking once will succeed).
ffmpeg still missing from PATH — test_start_with_key_success_and_stop skipped. Same as iteration 4.

issues: Legacy Stripe USD row still shows '$4.99' correctly rendered (fixed in previous iteration via txn.currency check) — cosmetic remnant of Stripe test data. New Razorpay txns render as ₹35/₹199/₹599 correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py razorpay_verify_payment renewal logic (lines 805-828) correctly handles: (a) same-plan active → stack, (b) same-plan expired → reset from now, (c) different-plan → reset from now. Timezone handling is defensive (isinstance str + tz-naive normalization to utc). Verified by 3 new tests.

Frontend Billings.jsx (line 216-229): `disabled={isProcessing}` (only) — no longer `disabled={isProcessing || isCurrent}` — and label ternary correctly shows 'Renew / Recharge' when isCurrent, 'Buy Now' otherwise. This IS the bug fix and is properly wired to handlePurchase(plan.id) which reuses the exact same Razorpay checkout flow.

No 'activated_now: bool' flag in verify-payment response — a renewal that extends expiry looks identical to first-time activation from the client's perspective. Nice-to-have for a distinct 'Plan renewed! X days added' toast vs 'Plan activated'.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 bug fix VERIFIED: current-plan button on Billings is now enabled with 'Renew / Recharge' label, backend correctly STACKS same-plan renewals on top of remaining future validity (proven by 3 new backend tests) and RESETS when plan is expired or different. Razorpay LIVE keys are provider-throttled (~1 successful order/min); tests use _create_order_with_retry helper (6×8s backoff). If throttling worsens, either loosen retries or use test-mode keys for CI. Frontend fresh-user registration flow was NOT fully re-exercised in the browser this iteration because the /register submit didn't advance the URL in the automation session — the underlying billings behavior for a no-plan user is identical to what admin sees for non-current plans (both show enabled 'Buy Now'), so functionally covered. If E1 wants an explicit fresh-user UI check next iteration, provide the exact selector/testid for the register submit button (currently 'Create Account' role=button was clicked but no navigation occurred, possibly due to a validation state we didn't hit).
rca of the issue: USER REPORT: '₹35 recharge option missing'. RCA: The prior Billings.jsx disabled the buy button when isCurrent was true, so a user on the daily plan (already ₹35) could not re-buy/recharge their own plan — the daily card's button read 'Current Plan' and was inert. FIX (applied by E1 pre-testing): Billings.jsx line 218 changed to `disabled={isProcessing}` only, and label ternary shows 'Renew / Recharge' for current plan; server.py razorpay_verify_payment (lines 805-828) added expiry-stacking so re-buying the same active plan extends the existing future expiry by +duration_days instead of resetting from now (so users never lose paid-for time). Both fixes verified: (a) UI-side — admin's monthly card is now enabled with 'Renew / Recharge' and opens Razorpay for ₹599 on click; (b) backend-side — 3 new tests prove stacking-when-active, reset-when-expired, and reset-when-different-plan branches all work correctly.
